scope: Approved A Killer Among Us shared-catalog fixture repair

cases.name: the enters trigger makes the three 1/1 suspects, then offers only their three types
the choice is noted on the enchantment, secret to the player who made it
an attacking token of the chosen type gets three +1/+1 counters and deathtouch
an attacking token of the wrong type is a legal target that gets nothing
paying the reveal cost makes the note public
a player who gained control can't activate it — they never saw the choice
